description: ARM Key Vault with soft delete and purge protection off
note: CIS Azure 3.3.5. Without purge protection a vault deletion is immediate and irreversible, which destroys the secrets and any audit material with them. Relabelled 2026-09-23 when KICS replaced Trivy on ARM and Bicep: Trivy's ARM adapter could not satisfy four of its own checks (docs/trivy-azure-arm-adapter-gap.md), so the trivy:AZU-* labels here are gone and the KICS query that covers the same control takes their place.
